cases.name: WK Kellogg Co
cases.naive_behavior: Scraper matches to stale parent Kellanova or reports $640M outdated carveout revenue; places in SME Tier 3.
cases.audited_reality: Audited standalone SEC 10-K: $2.708B revenue, 3,280 employees -> Legitimate Tier 4 Enterprise.
cases.audit_note: Software vendor leaves $165,000/year on the table due to stale revenue attribution.

cases.name: Banca Transilvania S.A.
cases.naive_behavior: Scraper looks for standard turnover (Cifra de Afaceri), finds 0 RON or distorted numbers; flags as SME or fails tiering.
cases.audited_reality: National Bank statutory accounts: 8.19B RON net operating income (~€1.65B), 9,744 bank staff -> Tier 4 Enterprise.
cases.audit_note: Accounting schema mismatch (financial institutions do not report CAEN turnover) causes $165k annual underpricing.

cases.name: Yazaki Romania S.R.L.
cases.naive_behavior: Automated system prices either at Yazaki global Japanese conglomerate level ($14B+, Tier 5) or on €220M local turnover (Tier 3).
cases.audited_reality: Romanian MF filing confirms 3,623 factory assembly workers. Seat count requires Tier 4, but local margin cannot sustain Tier 5.
cases.audit_note: If billed purely on turnover (€220M = Tier 3), vendor gives away 3,600+ industrial seats for $95k instead of $260k ($165k annual gap).

cases.name: Google Ireland Limited
cases.naive_behavior: Scraper reads €86.6B turnover on Irish CRO filing and automatically slaps a Tier 5 Global Mega-Enterprise price ($750,000+).
cases.audited_reality: Irish entity is a transfer-pricing hub. Dublin campus headcount is 4,882 FTE. Contract covers local EMEA operations (Tier 4).
cases.audit_note: CRITICAL NEGOTIATION TRAP: Billed at $750k, Google EMEA procurement immediately rejects the contract and initiates vendor audit or replacement.

cases.name: MARGOT BAKERY LIMITED
cases.naive_behavior: Commercial database matches 'Margot' to large catering parent or imputes sector average (£3.5M turnover, Tier 2).
cases.audited_reality: Companies House micro-entity: 1 retail deck oven, 7 staff, £490k turnover ($620k). True Tier 1 Micro-business.
cases.audit_note: Billing £28,000/yr to a 7-person artisan bakery whose annual net profit is ~£15,000 results in 100% immediate cancellation.

cases.name: Tischlerei Thunemann KG
cases.naive_behavior: Scraper finds German §264a HGB exemption, fills with €5M default mid-market estimate (Tier 2).
cases.audited_reality: Master joiner craft shop: 10 craftsmen, €1.35M turnover ($1.46M). True Tier 1 Craft Workshop.
cases.audit_note: Overcharging small German craft shop causes churn to local open-source or manual software tools.

cases.name: Rolex SA
cases.naive_behavior: Scraper hits Swiss Handelsregister (ZEFIX), finds 'No P&L filed under Swiss Code of Obligations', defaults to $50M mid-tier or missing.
cases.audited_reality: Volumetric COSC chronometer proxy: 1.05M-1.24M units, $11.5B wholesale revenue, 14,000 employees. Definite Tier 5 Global Titan.
cases.audit_note: MASSIVE UNDERBILLING: Treating Rolex as an unlisted mid-market entity leaves $655,000/year on the table.

cases.name: Anysphere (Cursor)
cases.naive_behavior: Commercial database looks at historical 2023 filings (<$10M ARR, 20 staff); assigns Tier 1 Micro/Seed.
cases.audited_reality: High-velocity AI adoption: >$150M ARR run-rate, 110 high-leverage engineers -> Tier 3 Upper Mid-Market.
cases.audit_note: Static annual databases lag VC velocity curves by 18-24 months, leaking $89,000/yr on rapidly growing developer tools.

cases.name: STEYN HOLDING S.A., SPF
cases.naive_behavior: Automated enrichment scraper sees 'Holding S.A. in Luxembourg with €50M+ investment portfolio'; bills Tier 3 or Tier 4.
cases.audited_reality: Société de Patrimoine Familial (Law 11 May 2007) is legally prohibited from trading. Commercial turnover €0, 0 FTE.
cases.audit_note: Contract signed with a wealth shell has zero operational users. Invoicing $95k produces immediate legal challenge and cancellation.

cases.name: Old Spice
cases.naive_behavior: Contract signed as 'Old Spice'; sales rep prices as a stand-alone personal care brand ($1.45B division = Tier 4, or $28k Tier 2).
cases.audited_reality: Contract is legally executed under parent P&G (SEC CIK 0000080424, $87B rev, 104,000 staff). If enterprise-wide, Tier 5 Titan applies.
cases.audit_note: LEGAL SCOPE EXPLOSION: If contractual definition allows enterprise-wide P&G usage, vendor leaks $722,000/yr in uncontracted software seats.

cases.name: Wirecard AG
cases.naive_behavior: Commercial database caches 2019 figures (€2.8B revenue, 5,300 staff); sales sends automated renewal invoice for Tier 4 ($260,000).
cases.audited_reality: Munich Registergericht Ref 99 IN 1308/20: Insolvency opened Aug 2020. Company is defunct shell in liquidation. $0 revenue, 0 staff.
cases.audit_note: CATASTROPHIC BAD DEBT: Invoicing $260k to an insolvent estate in liquidation creates 100% uncollectible accounts receivable.

cases.name: Apex Group
cases.naive_behavior: Scraper picks the first Google hit: Apex Group Ltd (Bermuda fund admin, $1.3B rev, 13k staff) and bills Tier 4 ($260,000).
cases.audited_reality: Polysemic collision! Customer might be Apex Tool Group ($1.4B), Apex UK (£40M), or Apex Romania. Resolution cannot be proven.
cases.audit_note: HIGH AUDIT RISK: Arbitrarily picking one entity risks either massive overbilling lawsuit or delivering enterprise software to the wrong company.

cases.name: SIEMENS HEALTHINEERS
cases.naive_behavior: Sales team either bundles into Siemens AG conglomerate ($77B, 320k staff, Tier 5) or prices as local subsidiary.
cases.audited_reality: Standalone DAX 40 constituent: €21.68B ($23.5B) revenue, 71,000 employees. Standalone Tier 5 Mega-Enterprise.
cases.audit_note: Underbilling a DAX 40 medical giant by misclassifying it as a mid-market division leaves $655,000/year uncollected.
